message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to current air‑quality data. For the most up‑to‑date information you can check one of the following:

| Source | How to get it |
|--------|---------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code, and view the latest AQI reading. |
| **AQICN** (World Air Quality Index) | Go to https://aqicn.org/, search for “Los Angeles”, and see the current AQI, pollutant breakdown, and forecast. |
| **Local news sites** | Many local stations publish live air‑quality dashboards on their websites or mobile apps. |
| **Mobile apps** | Apps such as *Plume Labs: Air Report*, *EPA AirNow*, or *AirVisual* show real‑time AQI values for specific locations. |

If you’re looking for historical trends or want to analyze how LA’s air quality has changed over time, let me know—I can help you find datasets or explain how to interpret them.
